title: Stop Going in Circles:Loop-Triggered Routing for System 1 Decision Agents
title_zh: 别再原地打转：面向 System 1 决策智能体的循环触发路由
abstract_en: System 1 decision models (represented by Jev) provide fast, low-cost action selection, but existing agent integrations do not reliably translate these local advantages into task completion. At certain points during execution, an agent may repeatedly select the same actions without making progress toward its goal. LLM-based policies offer strong reasoning capabilities that support planning within an agent, but invoking them at every step incurs substantial overhead. The effective coordination should therefore preserve Jev's fast local action selection while introducing LLM reasoning when execution stalls. We observe that recurring state-action pairs can signal stalled execution. We therefore propose LoopRoute, a simple but effective action router that uses this signal to allocate control within an agent. The decision model acts by default. When a loop is detected, the LLM provides brief, feedback-driven assistance and then returns control to the decision model. Later loops can request further assistance. The rule requires neither additional training nor model-specific confidence calibration. Across three benchmarks and seven LLMs, LoopRoute improves task success over standalone Jev with only limited use of the LLM policy. The mean gains are 21.0%, 60.1%, and 30.1% on ALFWorld, MapReader, and TextWorld cooking, respectively. Compared with full LLM control, LoopRoute also substantially reduces the mean cumulative API time and API-call cost per task. The same rule also improves the success rates of six frozen decision models.
abstract_zh: 以 Jev 为代表的 System 1 决策模型能快速、低成本地选择动作，但这种局部优势并不总能转化为任务成功：智能体可能反复执行相同动作，却无法取得进展。LLM 能提供更强的推理与规划能力，但逐步调用的开销较高。论文提出 LoopRoute：默认由决策模型控制，检测到状态–动作对重复出现时，才让 LLM 根据执行反馈短暂介入，随后将控制权交还给决策模型；若之后再次陷入循环，则可重新请求协助。该规则无需额外训练，也无需针对特定模型校准置信度。在涵盖三个基准和七种 LLM 的评估中，相较于独立运行的 Jev，LoopRoute 在 ALFWorld、MapReader 和 TextWorld cooking 上的任务成功率平均分别提高 21.0%、60.1% 和 30.1%。相较于全程由 LLM 控制，LoopRoute 显著降低了每项任务的平均累计 API 耗时和调用成本。同一规则也提升了六个冻结决策模型的成功率。
key_points_zh: 以重复出现的状态–动作对作为执行停滞的信号，无需额外训练或置信度校准。
Jev 默认控制；检测到循环后，LLM 根据反馈短暂协助并交还控制权，再次陷入循环时可重新介入。
相较于独立运行的 Jev，ALFWorld、MapReader 和 TextWorld cooking 的任务成功率平均分别提升 21.0%、60.1% 和 30.1%。
相较于全程 LLM 控制，每项任务的平均累计 API 耗时和调用成本均显著降低；同一规则还提升了六个冻结决策模型的成功率。
